title: Super Typhoon Rosal to bring significant rains in PH by Thursday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Super Typhoon Rosal off Central Luzon is expected to bring significant rainfall to parts of the country starting Thursday afternoon, Oct. 22, after it slightly intensified, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 p.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that Rosal slightly intensified as it moved west-northwestward over Central Luzon. READ: Wind Signal No. 1 raised in 6 Luzon areas due to Super Typhoon Rosal Pagasa weather specialist Benison Estareja said heavy rainfall could affect parts of the country by Thursday afternoon as Rosal moves closer to the Philippine landmass.
